literal_meaning: তলা অর্থে তলা / গভীরতম স্তরে স্তর
figurative_meaning_en: secretly, inwardly or behind the scenes
example_sentences_in_english: They made a deal secretly under the layers.
He takes bribes behind the scenes.
note: Idiom evokes imagery of hidden depths, common in Bengali colloquial speech for clandestine activities.
